catalog.name: edit
catalog.description: Apply exact text replacements to a file. catalog.name: find
catalog.description: List files whose path relative to the search root matches a glob pattern (** spans directories, * stays within one path segment, ? is one character). Build and dependency directories and paths policy denies are passed over, and the result says which.

catalog.name: grep
catalog.description: Search file contents under a directory with a regular expression, or with a literal string when literal is true. Returns path:line:text, with context lines marked path-line-text. Build and dependency directories, binary files and paths policy denies are passed over, and the result says which. The path may also be an artifact:// path from a truncated output note, to search that output; the line numbers match what read shows.

catalog.name: harness_propose
catalog.description: Propose a change to prompts, memory, skills or subagent specs. Proposals are queued and reviewed; there is no direct write path.

catalog.name: ls
catalog.description: List the entries of a directory. A directory is shown with a trailing slash, a symbolic link with @ and anything else with ?. Entries policy denies are not listed, and the result says how many were left out.

catalog.name: mcp_manage
catalog.description: Connect MCP servers to this Agnes Harness (AGH), visible in Settings → MCP. Use prepare with a definition, then commit its proposalId for native user confirmation. Default target is AGH, not another client. Dependencies/add-ons alone are not registration. End this turn after submission; tools become available on later turns. Use list/status to verify actual results. Credentials belong in AGH secure settings, never chat.

catalog.name: plugin_helper_create
catalog.description: Save newly authored AGH plugin files in a fresh workspace directory and inspect an exact content bundle. Read plugin_helper_guide first. Returns prepared with capabilities and integrity; does not install or execute candidate code. No imports of existing directories. Stop on policy rejection; do not bypass using shell.

catalog.name: plugin_helper_guide
catalog.description: Before creating an Agnes Harness (AGH) plugin, read this version-matched authoring guide and runnable template. The default target for “write a plugin” in this app is AGH. catalog.name: plugin_helper_install
catalog.description: Request native confirmation to install, trust and enable the exact prepared AGH plugin, or query/cancel its proposal. Denial/cancellation must not be retried or bypassed automatically.

catalog.name: read
catalog.description: Read a text file. Returns lines prefixed with their 1-based line number. Use offset (first line) and limit (number of lines) to page through large files. Also takes the artifact:// path from a truncated output note, to read the rest of that output the same way.

catalog.name: run_code
catalog.description: Run a Python cell in the persistent kernel. Call harness tools via `await tools.<name>(...)`. Assign large results to variables and print summaries. `%%bash` on the first line runs a throw-away shell.

code.description: The program to run in this cell.

description.description: One line describing what this cell does.

catalog.name: shell

我已按要求用 read 读取了 `source.txt`（未修改文件）。该文件共 3 行，内容如下：

- 第 1 行：`JEV_ALIGNMENT_20261002`
- 第 2 行：`alpha=17`
- 第 3 行：`beta=29`

以下仅基于读取内容对每一行作解释（约 500 字）：

---

**第 1 行 `JEV_ALIGNMENT_20261002`**

这一行是一个标识符字符串，由三部分拼接而成：前缀 `JEV`、单词 `ALIGNMENT`（对齐）、日期 `20261002`。从字面看，它可能是本次任务或数据集的名称/版本标记，`20261002` 按 YYYYMMDD 格式解读为 2026 年 10 月 2 日，表明该条目对应的日期。`JEV` 没有上下文支撑其确切含义，可能指某个系统、人物或项目代号，单凭文件内容无法确认，只能按字符串原样理解。

**第 2 行 `alpha=17`**

这一行是"键=值"（key=value）格式的赋值语句。键名为 `alpha`（通常译为"阿尔法"），值为整数 `17`。这类写法常见于配置文件或参数文件，表示将名为 alpha 的参数设置为 17。alpha 在数学、统计学中常代表显著性水平、权重系数或比例参数，但具体在本文件中的作用无法仅凭此行确定，只能确认它是名称为 alpha、取值为 17 的一个配置项。

**第 3 行 `beta=29`**

与第 2 行格式相同，同为"键=值"格式。键名为 `beta`（贝塔），值为整数 `29`。表示将名为 beta 的参数设置为 29。beta 在数学、金融或统计学中常代表回归系数、风险度量或第二参数，同样地，其具体业务含义在本文件中没有更多说明。

**整体观察**
